scope: 640x640 hero/side/top at frame 18. Actual raw Cycles and separately labeled HDR color-only OIDN images inspected. Acceptance covers the clear-pour diagnostic still-look cues, not arbitrary scene generation, calibrated physical accuracy, final-film temporal quality, or GLB parity.

criteria.observation: Stream has visible edge/reflection contrast from the supported feed source to impact in all three views.
The receiving surface is planar/elliptical in perspective with bounded edge curvature; it connects to the stream without an isolated terminal nub.
Finite cup wall/rim/base cues remain legible, with coherent straighter wall reflections.

Fill reads as one continuous region within the vessel; earlier broad black bands and bulb/stacked-insert cues are removed. Neutral lower tone is consistent with the featureless studio ground; it is not treated as proof of opacity.
Glass-like boundary reflections/transmission cues remain distinct from the opaque reflective metal witness; both have grounded shadow/contact cues.
No excessive bloom, broad milky wash or uncontrolled clipped-white presentation is apparent.

resolved_findings: V2-INTERFACE broad black horizontal fill bands

remaining_nonblocking_findings.observation: Raw 96-sample images remain grainy. Color-only OIDN removes most grain while softening some fine transparent detail.
remaining_nonblocking_findings.acceptance_check: Keep raw/cleaned outputs separate and inspect actual final-look motion for temporal stability before any final-film claim.

remaining_nonblocking_findings.observation: Featureless neutral background limits how strongly refracted background detail can be demonstrated.
remaining_nonblocking_findings.acceptance_check: For a future quantitative or exact-reference optical test, use an explicitly defined background target and controlled capture; no such calibration is claimed now.

reference_comparison.result: Qualitative continuity, clear-boundary and connected-impact cues are consistent with the inspected manufacturer photos.
reference_comparison.limitations: Different cup material/thickness, background, source and camera. No exact similarity score, material-constant inference or photographic match claim.

geometry_evidence.observed_report: All 36 evaluated frames are single-component/manifold/positive-volume with monotonically increasing resin volume.
geometry_evidence.limitation: Source geometry evidence does not substitute for motion-pixel or fluid-physics validation.

representation_limits: Source retains shape-key inputs, but live Boolean evaluated resin topology changes.
